nodes.title: Locations: pick a direction
nodes.description: Five concept passes for a non-desert location, each a reskin of the current in-game run screenshot (batch5-ingame-run). Reference mockups only, not production art.

data.text: Five non-desert passes, drawn at the game's own 320x180 art resolution with the real T-Rex, eggs and HUD so they read like real screenshots (no image model is connected, so nothing was AI-generated). Each keeps the run the same (ground height, obstacle footprints, egg arc) and swaps only sky, parallax layers, ground and the cactus stand-ins. The GDD already lists jungle, volcano and ice as later scenes; Coast and Glow Swamp are new. Pick one, or mix (e.g. Swamp mushrooms in the Jungle), and it goes into the GDD and gets redrawn in Aseprite like batch 6.

nodes.title: How to read these
nodes.description: Notes for picking a location direction.

data.prompt: Redraw this game screenshot as the same 16-bit SNES-style pixel art side-scrolling runner, keeping the exact same layout and camera: the same slate-gray pixel T-Rex with a big head and tiny arms running on the left on a flat ground line at the same height, the same arc of small cream eggs with orange speckles, the same HUD (egg counter top left, score top center, pause button top right), crisp pixels, dark outlines, flat readable ground, strong obstacle silhouettes, 3 parallax background layers plus a far sky. Change only the location: lush prehistoric jungle in warm morning light: giant ferns, cycads and tall tree trunks with hanging vines in the parallax layers, a misty waterfall far back, a mossy dark-green dirt ground with small pebbles; the cacti are replaced by spiky thorn bushes and a fallen log, same sizes and positions. Palette: deep greens, teal shadows, golden light shafts. No desert, no sand, no saguaro cactus, no text other than the HUD, no watermark, not photorealistic, no blur.

nodes.title: Pass 1: Fern Jungle
nodes.description: Reference mockup, not production art. Morning jungle: canopy and vines, light shafts, a waterfall far back, fern line, dark dirt ground. Thorn bushes for small cacti, an upright log for the big one. The prompt is kept for an AI pass once an image model is connected.

Change only the location: volcanic badlands at dusk: a smoking volcano with glowing orange lava streams in the far layer, dark basalt cliffs and ash clouds in the middle layers, a charcoal rock ground with faint glowing cracks; the cacti are replaced by jagged black obsidian spikes with orange rims, same sizes and positions. Palette: charcoal, maroon sky, hot orange and yellow accents, ember particles. No desert, no sand, no saguaro cactus, no text other than the HUD, no watermark, not photorealistic, no blur.
